reviewed_by: Codex focused review for Core throughput scheduler, ledger, compaction, and parallel tools
reason: The change adds durable provider admission, append-only turn history and checkpoints, bounded replay context, completion recovery, explicit safe parallel tool waves, and queued-turn Sessions lifecycle. The selection covers concurrency limits and lane reservation, a 120-step compact projection and replay reduction, provider tool ordering/barriers, context pruning, callback and restart behavior, migrations, client mapping, saved-session state, queued refresh/cancel across Chromium and WebKit, and real-Core reconnect behavior.
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. Harness adapters, terminal, browser automation, artifacts outside chat receipts, native Rust/Tauri packaging, reports, findings, and unrelated workspace journeys are unchanged. Production deployment is excluded; validation uses an isolated Core and database on a non-production port.
